paper_title: A Search for Invisible Axion Dark Matter with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: ADMX Run 1A (2018): first haloscope to reach DFSZ sensitivity. Paper excludes DFSZ axions (100% of DM, rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3 isothermal halo; also 0.63 GeV/cm^3 N-body lineshape) over 645-676 MHz (2.66-2.80 ueV). No numerical table is provided; the exclusion is stated as reaching the DFSZ coupling, so the emitted points are the DFSZ-level g_agamma values (~4e-16 GeV^-1 at these masses, scaling linearly with mass) spanning the stated mass range, approximated from the text/Fig. 4. Region 660.16-660.27 MHz was vetoed for RF interference. 90% CL limit. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.6, 4))
